items.title: Matthew Maxey Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tony, you don't remember the names of the songs that were singing here when you got here?

ctx.x: Well, now those songs that was used by lots of them, but mostly by those that's who put that record out. They was mostly the ones that done that singing of that type. Most of the time when I sang, I'd mostly sang to myself and I'd mostly sang the blues then. I'd mostly sang that.
Tony, you don't remember the names of the songs that were singing here when you got here?

I believe I remember one or two, but not too many of those. Would you sing a little bit of those, too? I believe I might could if I tried a little bit. I sort of have a think I could. Alright. Some of them come a little fast, some of them come a little slow. I woke up this morning. I was feeling awful bad. One of them was the feeling that I ever had. Keep on drinking. Trying to drive my blues away. But if I keep on drinking. Could be women. Got one to hold my mind. Got one to hold my mind. Got two to three women.…
